description: Scenarios for the command line: a vault (notes and board settings), and invocations (arguments, stdin, terminal, environment, clock). Each case records, per invocation, the exit code, stdout, stderr and the URLs opened by the TypeScript CLI, and the files in the vault at the end.

runs.out:
oprojects 0.2.0 — Jira-style cards for your Obsidian vault

Usage
  oprojects <command> [options]

Commands
  add      Create a card
  list     List cards (hides done cards older than the board setting; --all shows them)
  board    Show the kanban board (epics are hidden unless --epics)
  show     Show one card with its description
  comment  Add, edit or remove a comment on a card
  move     Move a card to another column (optionally next to a card)
  edit     Change fields of a card (use "none" to clear a field)
  rm       Delete a card (moved to the vault .trash, so it is recoverable)
  open     Open a card in Obsidian
  config   Show the board configuration in use
  init     Set up the board in this vault (folder + project key)

Global options
  --vault <path>   Vault to use (default: $OPROJECTS_VAULT, else nearest parent with .obsidian)
  --json           Machine-readable output
  --no-color       Disable colors (also honors NO_COLOR)
  -h, --help       Help for a command

Run oprojects <command> --help for details.

oprojects 0.2.0 — Jira-style cards for your Obsidian vault

Usage
  oprojects <command> [options]

Commands
  add      Create a card
  list     List cards (hides done cards older than the board setting; --all shows them)
  board    Show the kanban board (epics are hidden unless --epics)
  show     Show one card with its description
  comment  Add, edit or remove a comment on a card
  move     Move a card to another column (optionally next to a card)
  edit     Change fields of a card (use "none" to clear a field)
  rm       Delete a card (moved to the vault .trash, so it is recoverable)
  open     Open a card in Obsidian
  config   Show the board configuration in use
  init     Set up the board in this vault (folder + project key)

Global options
  --vault <path>   Vault to use (default: $OPROJECTS_VAULT, else nearest parent with .obsidian)
  --json           Machine-readable output
  --no-color       Disable colors (also honors NO_COLOR)
  -h, --help       Help for a command

Run oprojects <command> --help for details.
